subject: Island 014 Royal Palace replacement naked macro shell

reviewPolicy.hiddenViews: volume-coherence only; source likeness is not scored where the source provides no exact hidden authority

perViewScores.note: Closed tiering is credible and the front no longer collapses, but the equal-weight ziggurat setbacks suppress the source's tall central cathedral, raised satellite towers, and vertically continuous shoulder hierarchy.
The replacement preserves real depth and seated volumes. Its broad horizontal tiers still dominate over the source's narrow, upward-driving keep and interlocked tower shoulders.
Hidden side is structurally coherent with closed setbacks and embedded towers; central keep and satellites remain vertically compressed.

The retired family's least-flattering transition is repaired: no planar collapse, open root slot, or floating crown is visible. The mass is coherent but reads as a stepped monument rather than a cathedral.
Rear volume is closed, symmetric, and seated. Uniform tier proportions and low satellites keep the upper hierarchy generic.
Opposite transition confirms the replacement family's genuine depth and eliminates the previous camera-dependent slab failure. Vertical cathedral identity remains underdeveloped.
Opposite side remains coherent, with the same compressed keep and low tower shoulder problem.
Front-adjacent recovery is stable but too horizontally stepped; the source's satellite towers should climb beside and visually lock into the central keep.

deltaAgainstRetiredFamily.summary: The replacement clearly fixes planar collapse and exceeds the required +0.10 worst-score gain, but remains below the 0.85 approval gate because its mass distribution reads as a ziggurat rather than the source's vertically integrated cathedral.

largestMismatch: Four similarly weighted horizontal tiers dominate the silhouette, while the source concentrates height in a narrow central keep and uses four taller satellite towers to create interlocking vertical shoulders. The current family is genuinely three-dimensional but its hierarchy is too pyramidal and generic.

boundedCorrection.falsifiableHypothesis: Redistributing existing closed-volume height from the broad equal-weight lower tiers into a taller, narrower central keep and visibly raised embedded satellite towers will change the exact front read from a ziggurat to the source's vertically integrated cathedral while preserving the replacement family's repaired side/rear coherence.
allowedVariablesAndFeatures: X and Z dimensions, Y heights, and setback amounts of the four existing closed lower tiers
X, Z, and Y dimensions and seating height of the existing closed central keep
X/Z embed positions and Y heights of exactly four existing satellite tower masses
Y seating and scale of the existing hero dome, upper lantern, and crown dome within build-contract source targets
frozenDuringCorrection: part count and closed-volume construction rule
materials, honey, mission, robots, terrain, camera, and gameplay
boundedCorrection.hardRejectThreshold: Retire the family if the corrected worst required score is below 0.75, if worst-score gain is below +0.10, if any critical dimension regresses by more than 0.05, or if any camera-dependent/open-slot/floating-volume veto returns. Approval remains impossible unless every required score reaches 0.85.
